verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents an official MCP server that works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf. Through it, an agent can run CRM operations in natural language and query standard and custom modules with COQL, so it can pull open deals and account records for a pre-meeting brief. The REST API adds record retrieval, related-list metadata, relationship-aware queries and composite calls. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that emails and activity/timeline history are exposed through the API or MCP, a documented account-brief or meeting-prep workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
